text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — after the kernel-selector tweak (r34) the cross-zone tail latencies have crept up when spillback happens. p99 for eu->us requests is +70ms.
Dmitri: Do we have profiler output? where is the CPU/PCIe pressure showing up?
Maria: Pasted a short profile from last night canary:
```
sample: 2025-11-23 03:12
p99_latency_ms: 320 -> 390
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.78
kernel: aten_kernel_select_v2 (r34)
hotspots: memcpy(+18%), allreduce_kernel(+6%)
queue_depths: eu-west: 42, us-west: 12
```
Kevin: That queue_depth pattern screams cross-zone spillback. eu cluster is forming large batches -> local KV miss rate goes down then requests spill to us.
Jordan: We should try soft-affinity + token-budget per-cluster. i.e. prefer local execution unless local queue depth > X or wait_time > T. That avoids immediate spillover for short requests.
Lee: perf-bot reported a regression tied to the new kernel selection heuristic:
perf-bot: "regression detected: aten_kernel_memcpy cost +12% on r34 (p95 tokens/sec down)."
Maria: Ideas for continuous batching tweaks? I'm thinking: reduce max-batch-window for eu from 12ms -> 8ms and drop token_budget target from 1024 -> 768 for that region.
Dmitri: Also worth limiting cross-zone spillback rate to <5% of inflight requests per AZ — treat spillover as emergency path.
Kevin: Config sketch:
```
soft_affinity: true
local_thresholds:
  max_queue_depth: 30
  max_wait_ms: 10
token_budget_targets:
  eu-west: 768
  us-west: 1024
spillover_limits:
  per_az_pct: 5
```
Jordan: We should run a two-week canary: group A = soft-affinity + reduced token budget in eu, group B = rollback r34 selector but keep other optimizations. Monitor p50/p95/p99, KV hit by origin, cost/token.
Lee: On kernel side, I'll add micro-benchmarks focused on memcpy patterns and async DMA to see if we can recovery some of the r34 regression.
Maria: For metrics dashboard, add these panels: origin_kv_hit_rate, spillover_rate_by_az, p99_crosszone_latency, batching_window_ms, avg_batch_size.
Kevin: I'll create the perf experiment PR and a ci-run job that toggles soft_affinity per-cluster.
Dmitri: Also add a short flamegraph capture for the canary at peak QPS — helps debug where memcpy blows up.
Maria: Sounds good. Action items: Kevin -> PR and canary config; Lee -> kernel microbench; Dmitri -> flamegraph hooks; Jordan -> define experiment criteria (rollback thresholds); Maria -> dashboard panels.
Kevin: I'll target starting the canary tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Jordan: If spillover_rate > 3% and p99_crosszone > +50ms we rollback selector immediately.
Maria: Cool — keep updates in this thread and drop the canary logs here.
